The Imperial German Army (1871–1919), officially referred to as the German Army ( German : Deutsches Heer ), [ 11 ] was the unified ground and air force of the German Empire . It was established in 1871 with the political unification of Germany under the leadership of Prussia , and was dissolved in 1919, after the defeat of the German Empire in World War I (1914–1918). In the Federal Republic of Germany, the term Deutsches Heer refers to the German Army , the land component of the Bundeswehr .
